mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_login_log (admin_id, username, login_type, result_code, reason, ip, user_agent, created_at) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{username}, #{loginType}, #{resultCode}, #{reason}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, admin_id, username, login_type, result_code, reason, ip, user_agent, created_at FROM admin_login_log WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
